tasks.title: Compute marginal contribution including shared dependencies
tasks.goal: Compare complete baseline and candidate closures rather than summing package sizes.
steps: Consume M-05-E exact candidate graph with requested/resolved choices and technical provider edges.
Compute direct, inclusive and marginal measures from complete before/after worlds.
Attribute shared/transitive dependencies and changed configuration once; document non-additivity across independent experiments.
positive_cases: Adding a package sharing an existing dependency has smaller marginal than inclusive footprint.
negative_cases: Double-counted shared dependencies and summed independent deltas fail.
Unknown transitive capture cannot become zero cost.

tasks.title: Expose install, remove and reconfigure scenarios
tasks.goal: Make preinstall what-if useful across conditions and branch changes.
steps: Add scenario controls for add/remove/toggle/reconfigure using immutable candidate requests.
Bind OS/target conditions and legal loading options; show potential conditional contributions without assuming future context.
Compare changes in package/feature/dependency/provenance and cost through one API/UI model.
positive_cases: Changing continuity branch preserves unrelated shared contributions in the comparison.
negative_cases: Missing mandatory selection and illegal static/dynamic placement return typed incompatibility.
Unknown future conditions cannot be reported as exact total session cost.
